method: AlphaMemo released graph-memory search and native downstream model, with a monthly U.S.portfolio adapter
source_core: Unchanged run_search, GraphMemoryStrategy, FactorDAG, ResidualMemory, AsymmetricAPV, FormulaEvaluator, OpenAICompatibleGenerator prompts/extraction/fallback behavior, Qlib exporter and LGBModel settings.

data.training_labels: Native20-trading-day label uses only the physically bounded search provider. Downstream train/valid labels are purged so their realization endpoints stay inside the declared selection/valid windows.
data.universe: Released source SP500 membership intervals, not largest1000or a pristine historical membership vintage. Only formation-time identifier/positive market-equity availability may restrict the monthly investable mapping; never future-return availability.

model.basis: The literal released run_main.sh model route, with a pinned provider supporting ordinal request seeds. All current provider endpoint tariffs are bounded before reservation.
model.reasoning: No new reasoning override; preserve source request shape. Returned truncations/parse failures/fallbacks are recorded as source behavior, not regenerated.

metering.network_retry: None. A transport/budget stop bypasses source retry-and-fallback using a fatal BaseException. Never resubmit an uncertain request.
metering.key_source: Only OPENROUTER_API_KEY from /nfs/roberts/project/pi_btk22/zc362/KnowledgeTemplate/.env; no other credentials loaded.

adapters: Canonical transport replaces only the HTTP request boundary; original generation prompts, response extraction and returned-response fallback remain.
Disable source generic dotenv loading to avoid reading unrelated credentials.
Correct the exporter template-directory location to the actual archived templates path; no scientific setting change.
Use monthly rather than daily Top50/drop5 decisions, maintaining source lookback units/model/selection. This is a declared transfer, not original-paper execution equivalence.

monthly_account.signal_clock: Last fully available prior-session prediction before month-end; form holdings before month-end close, hold through next month-end.
monthly_account.portfolio: Source Top50/drop5 ranking and equal target weights; trade once per month. Preserve held positions and source-style turnover constraints; no hindsight selection.
monthly_account.return_source: JKP raw monthly dividend-inclusive ret aligned by unique valid ticker/permno/date intervals. Subtract actual French RF for long-only net excess return.
monthly_account.missing_realizations: Primary zero return without future reweighting plus adverse-100 sensitivity; report affected weights.
monthly_account.baseline: The same four-source-feature downstream model without discovered factors, identical training/portfolio/account settings; control diagnostic, not a selected replacement.

primary_test: Full-method net excess return intercept against actualFF5+MOM+fixedJKP132; recheck rank anddf on exact191monthdeclared calendar. Approximate HAC inference, retrospective development evidence, denominator69 preserved.
claims: No freshholdout, no original historical model equivalence, no full original-paper reproduction; eligible as a source-core-preserving monthly transfer only if actual conformance/prefix/account checks pass.
